_comment: Settings for the web admin service only (deployed to /etc/door_access/web.json). Kept separate from config.json so the web user never needs read access to the door service's config, which holds the MQTT password. The listen address lives in web.env.
_tls_ca: Public CA certificate, served unauthenticated at /ca.crt so a device can be taught to trust this site. The signing key (ca-key.pem) is never served.
_allow_update: Set false to remove the Updates page entirely. Applying an update runs code from the git remote as root on this machine, so turn it off if anyone other than you can reach a dooradmin account.
